mapper.sql: id, source_type, source_organization_id, creator_user_id, title, difficulty_level, base_points, duration_minutes, scheduled_date, category_code, remark, reviewer_user_id, review_timeout_hours, recurrence_enabled, recurrence_end_date, status, published_at, created_at, updated_at, (SELECT recurrence.status FROM learn_task_recurrence recurrence WHERE recurrence.task_id = learn_task.id) AS recurrence_status, recurrence_frequency, recurrence_weekdays, description, requirement_items, example_file_ids, task_type, end_date, visibility
mapper.select: SELECT FROM learn_task WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
mapper.sql: (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM learn_task_assignment overview_assignment WHERE overview_assignment.task_id = learn_task.id AND overview_assignment.current_status <> 'INVALIDATED') AS assignment_total, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM learn_task_assignment overview_assignment WHERE overview_assignment.task_id = learn_task.id AND overview_assignment.current_status = 'COMPLETED') AS assignment_completed, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM learn_task_assignment overview_assignment WHERE overview_assignment.task_id = learn_task.id AND overview_assignment.current_status = 'PENDING_REVIEW') AS assignment_pending_review, (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT overview_student.student_name ORDER BY overview_student.id SEPARATOR '、') FROM learn_task_assignment overview_assignment JOIN edu_student overview_student ON overview_student.id = overview_assignment.student_id WHERE overview_assignment.task_id = learn_task.id AND overview_assignment.current_status <> 'INVALIDATED') AS member_names

sql.if: AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM learn_task_assignment overview_filter_assignment WHERE overview_filter_assignment.task_id = learn_task.id AND overview_filter_assignment.student_id = #{query.studentId} AND overview_filter_assignment.current_status <> 'INVALIDATED')

choose.when: AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM learn_task_assignment overview_tab_assignment WHERE overview_tab_assignment.task_id = learn_task.id AND overview_tab_assignment.current_status = 'PENDING_REVIEW')

AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM learn_task_assignment overview_tab_any WHERE overview_tab_any.task_id = learn_task.id AND overview_tab_any.current_status <> 'INVALIDATED') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM learn_task_assignment overview_tab_open WHERE overview_tab_open.task_id = learn_task.id AND overview_tab_open.current_status NOT IN ('COMPLETED', 'INVALIDATED', 'EXEMPT'))

AND learn_task.status = 'PUBLISHED' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM learn_task_assignment overview_tab_active WHERE overview_tab_active.task_id = learn_task.id AND overview_tab_active.current_status IN ('PENDING_CLAIM', 'IN_PROGRESS', 'NEEDS_IMPROVEMENT')) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM learn_task_assignment overview_tab_review WHERE overview_tab_review.task_id = learn_task.id AND overview_tab_review.current_status = 'PENDING_REVIEW')

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO learn_task ( id, source_type, source_organization_id, creator_user_id, title, difficulty_level, base_points, duration_minutes, scheduled_date, category_code, remark, reviewer_user_id, review_timeout_hours, recurrence_enabled, recurrence_end_date, status, recurrence_frequency, recurrence_weekdays, description, requirement_items, example_file_ids, task_type, end_date, visibility ) VALUES ( #{task.id}, #{task.sourceType}, #{task.sourceOrganizationId, jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{task.creatorUserId}, #{task.title}, #{task.difficultyLevel}, #{task.basePoints}, #{task.durationMinutes}, #{task.scheduledDate}, #{task.categoryCode, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{task.remark, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{task.reviewerUserId}, #{task.reviewTimeoutHours}, #{task.recurrenceEnabled}, #{task.recurrenceEndDate, jdbcType=DATE}, #{task.status}, #{task.recurrenceFrequency}, #{task.recurrenceWeekdays, jdbcType=VARCHAR, typeHandler=com.lingdong.learning.learningtask.infrastructure.persistence.TaskWeekdaysTypeHandler}, #{task.description, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{task.requirementItems, jdbcType=VARCHAR, typeHandler=com.lingdong.learning.learningtask.infrastructure.persistence.TaskStringListTypeHandler}, #{task.exampleFileIds, jdbcType=VARCHAR, typeHandler=com.lingdong.learning.learningtask.infrastructure.persistence.TaskFileIdListTypeHandler}, #{task.taskType, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{task.endDate, jdbcType=DATE}, #{task.visibility, jdbcType=VARCHAR} )
mapper.update: UPDATE learn_task SET title = #{task.title}, difficulty_level = #{task.difficultyLevel}, base_points = #{task.basePoints}, duration_minutes = #{task.durationMinutes}, scheduled_date = #{task.scheduledDate}, category_code = #{task.categoryCode, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, remark = #{task.remark, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, reviewer_user_id = #{task.reviewerUserId}, recurrence_enabled = #{task.recurrenceEnabled}, recurrence_end_date = #{task.recurrenceEndDate, jdbcType=DATE}, recurrence_frequency = #{task.recurrenceFrequency}, recurrence_weekdays = #{task.recurrenceWeekdays, jdbcType=VARCHAR, typeHandler=com.lingdong.learning.learningtask.infrastructure.persistence.TaskWeekdaysTypeHandler}, description = #{task.description, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, requirement_items = #{task.requirementItems, jdbcType=VARCHAR, typeHandler=com.lingdong.learning.learningtask.infrastructure.persistence.TaskStringListTypeHandler}, example_file_ids = #{task.exampleFileIds, jdbcType=VARCHAR, typeHandler=com.lingdong.learning.learningtask.infrastructure.persistence.TaskFileIdListTypeHandler}, task_type = #{task.taskType, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, end_date = #{task.endDate, jdbcType=DATE}, visibility = #{task.visibility, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{task.id} AND status = 'DRAFT'
UPDATE learn_task SET status = 'PUBLISHED', published_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'DRAFT'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO learn_task ( id, source_type, source_organization_id, creator_user_id, title, difficulty_level, base_points, duration_minutes, scheduled_date, category_code, remark, reviewer_user_id, review_timeout_hours, recurrence_enabled, recurrence_end_date, status, published_at, generation_type, origin_task_id, description, requirement_items, example_file_ids, task_type, end_date, visibility ) SELECT #{targetTaskId}, source_type, source_organization_id, creator_user_id, title, difficulty_level, base_points, duration_minutes, #{targetDate}, category_code, remark, reviewer_user_id, review_timeout_hours, 0, NULL, 'PUBLISHED', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, 'DEFERRED', COALESCE(origin_task_id, id), description, requirement_items, example_file_ids, task_type, end_date, visibility FROM learn_task WHERE id = #{sourceTaskId} AND status = 'PUBLISHED'

INSERT INTO learn_task ( id, source_type, source_organization_id, creator_user_id, title, difficulty_level, base_points, duration_minutes, scheduled_date, category_code, remark, reviewer_user_id, review_timeout_hours, recurrence_enabled, recurrence_end_date, status, published_at, generation_type, origin_task_id, description, requirement_items, example_file_ids, task_type, end_date, visibility ) SELECT #{targetTaskId}, 'FAMILY', NULL, #{parentUserId}, title, difficulty_level, base_points, duration_minutes, #{targetDate}, category_code, remark, #{parentUserId}, review_timeout_hours, 0, NULL, 'PUBLISHED', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, 'COPIED', COALESCE(origin_task_id, id), description, requirement_items, example_file_ids, task_type, end_date, visibility FROM learn_task WHERE id = #{sourceTaskId} AND source_type = 'FAMILY' AND creator_user_id = #{parentUserId} AND status = 'PUBLISHED'
